title: Farmers' Alliance! Level 6
description: Farmers' Alliance! Level 6 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_A

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Ambush the Uber Banned Farmer on Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: QuestGiver_A

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Ambush the Uber Banned Farmer on Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

You know the drill, Dungeon Runner. Get in there and make sure the ambush goes off smoothly!

Go to Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag and ambush the Banned Uber Farmer before he can gold that farm. The Goodly Farmers are still behind you and will assist in the ambush once you are there. When the Banned Uber Farmer has been vanquished return to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

Great work. Let me know when you are ready to do this quest again.

Objectives:

  • Slay the Uber Banned Farmer on Level 6

Client level range: 85–100
